name: io.github.siteverdict/siteverdict
title: SiteVerdict — Website Audit Tools
description: Website audits for AI agents: GDPR consent, speed, WCAG, SPF/DMARC and AI-search readiness.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Apify API token. Audits run as Apify Actors on your account and are billed by Apify (pay-per-event).

environmentVariables.name: SITEVERDICT_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to return built-in sample data without calling Apify (for trying the tools).

environmentVariables.name: SITEVERDICT_DEFAULT_MAX_CHARGE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spend cap per Actor run in USD, forwarded to Apify as maxTotalChargeUsd.
